address: 30 rue de la Ferté, Saint-Valery-sur-Somme, 80230, France
bio: This tiny restaurant, which has only two tables for guests, proposes a short menu and sources its produce from suppliers who lie within a strict 100km radius. The natural ingredients are prepared without gimmicks, as in the monkfish roasted on the bone. Add to that the friendly welcome and you have one of the best places to eat in town. Given all that, you should really book!...
